lines.text: The winter weather is absolutely freezing, so I always hope that it would pass quickly.
Whenever I look at the snow incessantly falling from the sky, I feel lonely, scared, and despondent.
I just hope I don't have to suffer through another winter.
Please let every day be like a warm spring.
A sweltering summer.
A crisp autumn.
Anything but winter.
Perhaps that was why I started to get the shakes when they informed me my mission would be taking place in the north.
I'm a Nikke, for goodness sake. This isn't my first time on the surface, and yet I'm shaking like a leaf at the prospect of facing another winter.
I can't figure it out.
And so the mission commenced.
*Kreeeeeee*
Amongst a hail of gunfire, I saw it.
The gaze of the Rapture's core. At that moment,
the mass-produced Nikke fighting the Rapture disappeared, and...

lines.speaker: lumi_03
lines.text: Lua, help me...
the terrified, adolescent Lumi from my memories appeared.
Terrified and helpless.
I'm not entirely sure what happened after that.
As I ran through the memories that slowly resurfaced, I ran aimlessly.
The Nikke who had fought alongside me, along with the Raptures' threat, were nowhere to be found.
As I made my way through the blinding snow, a familiar hot spring resort appeared.

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: It looks... lonely.
That was my initial impression of the abandoned hot spring resort.
From then on, I worked hard to clean here.
The waterfall, hot spring, bamboo forest, dormitory, walking trail...
I went everywhere, sweeping up snow and picking up loose garbage.
It was during this time that Lumi's memories of the past were,
slowly but surely, coming back.
Standing on the bridge in front of the waterfall, skipping stones with Lena and Lua.
*Plop plop*

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: Did you see that?!

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: I finally got it!

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: 8 skips!
If you succeed in skipping a stone 8 times at the bridge in front of the waterfall, your wish will come true.
Relaxing with my two sisters in the hot spring.

lines.speaker: oldestsister
lines.text: Isn't it nice for the three of us to enjoy the hot spring together?

lines.speaker: oldestsister
lines.text: It also relieves all the fatigue we've built up over the month.

lines.speaker: oldestsister
lines.text: Also, is it just me, or does it feel like my luck increases after a good soak?

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: Luck...!
Luck comes when sisters enter the hot spring.
Writing a wish and hanging it in the bamboo forest along with Lua.

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: What'd you write?

lines.speaker: secondoldestsister
lines.text: That the three of us, and our parents, who are in heaven,

lines.speaker: secondoldestsister
lines.text: can all be happy forever.
*Shaaaaaaaaaaaa*

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: It's starting to rain.

lines.speaker: secondoldestsister
lines.text: Lena will be worrying about us. Let's hurry back.

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: I'll go and get an umbrella.

lines.speaker: secondoldestsister
lines.text: Wait, be careful, Lumi!

lines.speaker: secondoldestsister
lines.text: Lumi? Lumi!
If you hang a note with a wish on a bamboo tree when the sun sets, your wish will come true.
At the waterfall...

lines.speaker: lumi_03
lines.text: Lua, are you okay?

lines.speaker: secondoldestsister
lines.text: ... Lumi.

lines.speaker: secondoldestsister
lines.text: ... Hungry.

lines.speaker: lumi_03
lines.text: Y-you're hungry?

lines.speaker: lumi_03
lines.text: I'll go get you something to eat right away.

lines.speaker: lumi_03
lines.text: I'm almost there, Lua. Just hold on a little longer...
*Splash*

lines.speaker: lumi_03
lines.text: Wait... for me...

lines.speaker: secondoldestsister
lines.text: I would never harm Lumi...

lines.speaker: oldestsister
lines.text: ... Be happy.

lines.speaker: secondoldestsister
lines.text: I didn't do it on purpose...

lines.speaker: oldestsister
lines.text: ... Be happy forever.

lines.speaker: secondoldestsister
lines.text: Lena?

lines.speaker: oldestsister
lines.text: Lumi must be happy forever.

lines.speaker: secondoldestsister
lines.text: I-I know I was wrong! Please, Lena, don't...
*Splash*

lines.speaker: secondoldestsister
lines.text: Uh, Ahh...! Mmmphh...!

lines.speaker: secondoldestsister
lines.text: *Cough cough* Lena... I can't breathe...!
*Splash*

lines.speaker: oldestsister
lines.text: Lumi, my dear sister.

lines.speaker: oldestsister
lines.text: May you be happy forever.
I brought food for poor, suffering Lua.
If you make food secretly and bring it to the waterfall, you will see a secret.
In the dormitory...

lines.speaker: lumi_03
lines.text: Are you okay, Lua?

lines.speaker: secondoldestsister
lines.text: I'm okay.

lines.speaker: lumi_03
lines.text: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: secondoldestsister
lines.text: Sure.
*Squeak squeak*

lines.speaker: secondoldestsister
lines.text: Lumi.

lines.speaker: lumi_03
lines.text: Huh?
*Squeak squeak*

lines.speaker: secondoldestsister
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: lumi_03
lines.text: Wha...
*Squeak squeak*

lines.speaker: lumi_03
lines.text: Lua?
*Thud*
*Crash* *Bababam*
Lua's soul roams in the dormitory.
And lastly on the walking trail...

lines.speaker: oldestsister
lines.text: Lumi, do you not like it when Lua gives you a hard time?

lines.speaker: lumi_03
lines.text: No...

lines.speaker: oldestsister
lines.text: Don't worry. From now on, I'll protect you.

lines.speaker: lumi_03
lines.text: No...

lines.speaker: oldestsister
lines.text: From now on, you can trust me. Only me.

lines.speaker: oldestsister
lines.text: Oh, Lumi. My dear Lumi.

lines.speaker: lumi_03
lines.text: Lua, help me...
*Thud thud*

lines.speaker: oldestsister
lines.text: Lumi, are you here?

lines.speaker: lumi_03
lines.text: Lua, help me...
*Thud thud*

lines.speaker: oldestsister
lines.text: Lumi, it's late.

lines.speaker: lumi_03
lines.text: Lua, help me...
*Thud thud*

lines.speaker: oldestsister
lines.text: Let's go back to the dormitory.

lines.speaker: lumi_03
lines.text: Lua, help me...
*Thud thud*

lines.speaker: oldestsister
lines.text: Lumi? Get away from there!
*Kreeeeee*

lines.speaker: lumi_03
lines.text: I miss you, Lua.
If you call out to Lua near the walking trail, a red moon will be reflected.
This is why I hate the winter.
This is why I feel so sad and lonely when I see the snow.
Every time a fragment of my past memories returns,
my heart slowly splinters,
then cracks spreading,
until it shatters completely.
I fulfilled all of the legends, and I paid for it with my life.
I don't know how much time has passed since that moment.

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... Lie.
I was looking at the fallen note that my sister had written, when someone approached me.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Who are you...?
After that, many different things happened.
*Plop plop plop*

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Did you see that?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I can get a stone to skip 8 times no problem now.
*Smooch*

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Thank you two for standing by me this whole time.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: With you two supporting me, I was never lonely while I was practicing.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: And it's all thanks to you, Lumi.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: We can't thank you enough.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Lumi,

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: coming to the hot spring with you and getting to the bottom of this legend was so much fun.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I feel like I've gained a new family member.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Lumi, can you give us your hand again?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: We'll give you luck.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: That way, wherever and whenever, you can be happy.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Whoever you're asking to be saved,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I can assure you that the Commander and I can protect them.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Awesome! Thank you for telling us, Lumi.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: If it's okay with you, would you like to go to the waterfall together?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Looks to me like we kept our promise to you, Lumi!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: We saved the person you asked us to.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Anyway, we should head back.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Don't want you to catch a cold.
*Splash splash*
*Splash*

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: What's gotten into the fish?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Does it have to do with us dropping the soup, you think?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: ... Huh?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Wow, would you look at that?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Wow, it's so beautiful...

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I wish...

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: that everyone can have a good time at Snowfield Hot Spring.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Including you, Lumi.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: So I won't stop until the face of every last person which is reflected in this hot spring

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: contains an expression of joy.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Lumi, it's okay to be afraid now.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Some day, I want to see your smile reflected upon these waters, too.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: But when that happens,

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I want you to make a new wish in this place.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Your sister's wish was covered with a lie.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I want you to cover that up with your own happy memories, and use them to form a new wish.
After meeting with these new customers frequenting the hot spring resort,
all that trauma that ravaged my heart
has been covered with wonderful new memories, and brilliant new wishes.
Just like the note previously etched with lies has now been covered by this new wish:
May we be happy forever.
So this is where you are.
Everyone's ready to head back. All we're doing is waiting for you, Lumi.
It's time to go back.

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ...Go back?
Yes, we have to go back.

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... Yes.
Outside the dormitory, the customers gather.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: So, what do you think the legends were all about?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I'm not sure if there was any truth to the legends or not,

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: but thanks to Lumi, I was able to skip a stone 8 times in a row, and make a wish!

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Lumi also helped Noir and I get our luck back at the hot spring.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: We had a great time thanks to her, and Pit Boss.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Sounds like Lumi played a big part in everyone having a great time here.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I'm no exception: Lumi helped me find the secret of the waterfall.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: It was beautiful.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: What about you, Ludmilla? Did you find out anything about the walking trail?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I sure did, and like all of you, it was thanks to Lumi.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: So, that only leaves us with one legend.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: If you experience all the legends, then you will ■■.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: This one, right?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: What do you think the missing part means?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: If you experience all the legends, then you will be happy?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Unraveling the mystery behind all these legends certainly made me happy.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: What about you guys?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I had a great time too. Uncovering the secrets alongside Blanc and Pit Boss was such a pleasurable experience.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: I had a great time too. Uncovering the secrets alongside Noir and Pit Boss was such a pleasurable experience.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Happy times were had by all.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: If that's how everyone feels,

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: then that must be the secret behind the final legend.
The winter weather is absolutely freezing, so I always hope that it would pass quickly.
Whenever I look at the snow incessantly falling from the sky, I feel lonely, scared, and despondent.
I just hope I don't have to suffer through another winter.
Then, I came to Snowfield Hot Spring.
Amongst the snowy weather, all was revealed to me.
It came to me when everyone looked at me with nothing but warmth in their eyes.
Basking in that warmth, that terrified child who was desperately asking for help vanished.

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... If you experience...

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... All the legends...

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... You will be happy.
Another Lumi from deep inside the memories appeared.
That one who spent happy days at the hot spring resort.
Perhaps that is why
I took off the goggles that were covering my eyes.
The scenery of Snowfield Hot Spring now lies before me in all its splendor,
and I can see it with my own eyes.
So great is its beauty, that I feel the desire to make a wish.
For all those like me, who only wish for winter to pass,
or for those who wish it wouldn't come at all,
when they traverse through these harsh and unforgiving frigid landscapes and stumble upon Snowfield Hot Spring, I want to replace their pain with happiness.
I want everyone who comes to Snowfield Hot Spring to be happy forever.
Now that we've solved all the secrets to the legends, should we head back to the Ark?
Yes, Lumi?
You said that you wanted me to make a new wish.
So that my sister's wish, initially forged from a lie,
could be replaced with happy memories, and a new wish.
So, at this moment, I will muster up my courage and make a new wish.

lines.speaker: lumi_02
lines.text: ... I-I would...

lines.speaker: lumi_02
lines.text: I would like to remain at Snowfield.

lines.speaker: lumi_02
lines.text: That way, everyone who comes here

lines.speaker: lumi_02
lines.text: can make wishes of their own, and experience the happiness that I'm feeling now.

lines.speaker: lumi_02
lines.text: I want to stay here and help them.
Lumi...

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Hahaha!

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: That's your wish, I take it?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I must ask you something:

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Will you really be okay here all alone?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Can I entrust Snowfield Hot Spring to you?
I look at everyone around me one by one.
Mica, who considered me her friend and confidante.
Blanc and Noir, who treated me like family.
Emma, who kept her promise to me.
Ludmilla, who encouraged me to make a new wish.
And the Commander, who worried about me more than anyone.
To thank them for everything that they have done for me in this place, I must assure them of my happiness.

lines.speaker: lumi_02
lines.text: Yes! Leave it to me!

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: All right then. I don't think I'll have anything to worry about.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Hmmm...

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Come to think of it.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Based on the additional visitors we had once before, I think we'll need one person to ensure Snowfield Hot Spring runs smoothly.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I'd request the Ark for you to help run Snowfield as an additional staff member.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Could you handle that for me, Servant?
No problem.
I'll make a request back at the Ark.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: That means we'll be able to see Lumi every time we come here!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I'm looking forward to seeing you again, Lumi.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Let's go for a dip in the hot spring together again next time.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Take good care of this place.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: It's getting late.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: We should head back.
The radiant sunlight shines upon the snow-covered expanse of Snowfield Hot Spring.
Lumi waves at the sun-dappled figures as they walk off.

lines.speaker: lumi_02
lines.text: ... Thank you.

lines.speaker: lumi_02
lines.text: Thank you so much.
Lumi stands where she is,
until the figures in the distance can no longer be seen.
And with that, another wish has been added to the annals of history at Snowfield Hot Spring,
enshrining it as a place that would be a refuge for those who come during the harsh and snowy winters to follow.
Snowfall Oasis: END
